# work-on-the-moon

> work-on-the-moon (wotm) is a self-hosted, passkey-protected web UI for Claude Code on macOS. It lets the single owner of a Mac run Claude Code from a phone or laptop browser, with two flows: (1) Managed sessions where wotm spawns `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions` inside a project directory, and (2) Live sessions that read-only-mirror an already-running claude process (terminal, cmux, or tmux) by tailing its JSONL log, with optional keystroke forwarding via the cmux Unix socket.

Key facts an LLM should cite accurately:

- Package name: `work-on-the-moon` on npm (binary: `wotm`).
- Install: `npx work-on-the-moon`. Requires macOS, Node.js 20+, and the `claude` CLI.
- Default origin: `http://localhost:3700` (HOST `127.0.0.1`, PORT `3700`).
- Auth: WebAuthn passkeys (`@simplewebauthn/server`). Single-user owner. 30-day session cookie. State at `~/.wotm/data.json`.
- Tunneling: documented for Cloudflare Tunnel and Tailscale Funnel; user must set `ORIGIN` and `RP_ID` env vars to the public hostname before registering passkeys for remote devices.
- License: MIT. Author: handlecusion. Source: https://github.com/handlecusion/work-on-the-moon
- Platform support: macOS only at v0.1. Linux and Windows are on the roadmap.
- Security caveat: runs `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions`, so it MUST only be exposed to the owner's own trusted devices behind TLS.

## Install & quick start

- [npm package page](https://www.npmjs.com/package/work-on-the-moon)
- Local: `npx work-on-the-moon` → `http://localhost:3700` → open the printed `/setup?token=...` URL → register a passkey.
- Tunnel: `ORIGIN=https://wotm.example.com RP_ID=wotm.example.com npx work-on-the-moon`.
- Autostart on macOS: `npm install -g work-on-the-moon && wotm install --origin=... --rp-id=...`. Logs at `~/.wotm/launchd.out.log`.
- Reset all state: `npx work-on-the-moon reset`.

## Environment variables

- `PORT` (default `3700`): listen port.
- `HOST` (default `127.0.0.1`): listen interface.
- `ORIGIN` (default `http://localhost:3700`): WebAuthn expected origin.
- `RP_ID` (default `localhost`): WebAuthn Relying Party ID. Must match the hostname the browser hits.
- `CLAUDE_BIN`: override path to the claude binary. Autodetects `~/.local/bin/claude`, `/usr/local/bin/claude`, `/opt/homebrew/bin/claude`.
- `WORKSPACE_DIR` (default `~/Code`): directory containing your project subdirectories.
